decision_source: User requires user-facing prices to appear only in CNY or EUR.

user_visible_currency_rule.china_market_rule: China-market quotes remain displayed in CNY/¥.
user_visible_currency_rule.non_cny_market_rule: All non-CNY reference prices are converted to EUR/€ for the user-facing Excel.
user_visible_currency_rule.conversion_rule: Use a dated reference FX source at export time. Store FX date and source in the internal evidence/export metadata. Do not present the original foreign currency in the user-facing workbook.
user_visible_currency_rule.evidence_integrity_rule: The original quoted amount/currency remains preserved only in the underlying evidence JSON/source record so the conversion can be audited later.

keep_or_add_user_visible_fields: 汇率日期（仅发生换算时）
excel_field_change.display_format: Use ¥ for CNY and € for EUR. No other currency symbols/codes appear in the user-facing workbook.

market_rule: Source market remains visible even when a foreign-market quote is converted to EUR; conversion does not transform a foreign wholesale anchor into a China price band.
